column1: # Triage of the differences in REPORT.md, one line per jurisdiction and

column5: The households paid no state income tax during 2025 (none withheld, no estimates), so Schedule A line 5a has nothing to deduct and they take the standard deduction. PolicyEngine-US deducts the year's state income tax liability as if paid, itemizes, and so reports lower taxable income and tax.
As for tax_line_16: PolicyEngine-US deducts state income tax that was never paid.
